verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit lets users interact via natural-language chat to ask questions, challenge findings, teach preferences, and trigger actions (e.g., @coderabbitai review/full review/configuration commands, Slack agent 'Investigate' in natural language), plus one-click agentic actions and Claude Code integration triggering reviews via simple commands. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user confirmation that NL commands reliably control the full breadth of features, and clearer documentation of free-form (non-slash) natural language beyond the chat/Slack context.
